title: Safe Conversion
prompt: The starter crashes on non-numeric text. Wrap the conversion in try/except so the program prints bad input instead of crashing.

tests.name: no crash, friendly message
tests.code:
assert printed[0] == "bad input, skipping", f"got {printed}"
assert "except ValueError" in code, "catch ValueError specifically — a bare except hides real bugs (see lesson)"
tests.hint: try: number = int(text) / except ValueError: print("bad input, skipping")
